title: Cognitive Radio Network (CRN) Simulation with Jamming & Spectrum Sensing
summary: A Python simulation of a cognitive radio network modeling spectrum sensing, primary/secondary user priority, jamming attacks, and physical-layer signal processing with encryption. A separate script, ctgan_rf_synthesis.py, uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic tabular data for training a Random Forest classifier.
evidence: ctgan_rf_synthesis.py:18-19,140-142 imports and trains CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata
needs: unclear whether ctgan_rf_synthesis.py is central to the FYP-5G-Pipeline project or a side experiment, since README omits it entirely
